title: USCG Short; Chilled to the bone in Antarctica
description:
A chillaxing day at work! 
Coast Guard Petty Officers/Divers Chuck Fox and Corey Smith, crewmembers aboard the U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Polar Star, are shown here securing a shaft seal leak on the cutter while in the freezing waters of McMurdo Sound, Antarctica on January 27, 2024.
